topography.project_purpose: Ultron Staking Hub NFT is an Ultron-network staking and rewards product where users mint and stake an NFT representing a five-year plan to earn ULX rewards. External ULX token deployments on other EVM chains should be treated as ancillary token references, not as the core Staking Hub NFT protocol or its TVL basis.
topography.relationship_narrative: The ULX token family on other networks serves as the reward and staking token for the staking pools managed by the Ultron mainnet family. The proxy contracts (FuturaTreasury, Lottery, Autoplay, Platform) likely provide shared infrastructure for treasury management, lottery mechanics, automated play, and platform governance across both families.
